landing.heroSubtitle: Madaxtooyada rasmiga ah ee dawladda ee awoodda siinaysa muwaadiniinta, meheradaha, iyo machadyada aqoonta ay isaga difaacaan khataraha internetka.
landing.strategicPillarsDesc: Mabaadi'da hagaya ee tilmaamaya ballanqaadkayaga qaran ee deegaan dhijitaal ah oo ammaan ah dhammaan muwaadiniinta iyo ururada.
landing.pillar1Desc: In lagu qalabeeyo dhammaan muwaadiniinta iyo ururada xirfadaha aasaasiga ah ee amniga internetka iyada oo loo marayo qaybo is-dhexgal ah.
landing.pillar2Desc: In la bixiyo digniino waqtiyeysan oo la isku halayn karo oo ku saabsan ololayaasha madax-furashada iyo phishing-ka ee firfircoon.
landing.pillar3Desc: Bixinta tilmaamo iyo agabyo wax ku ool ah si loo sameeyo difaac dhijitaal ah oo xooggan dhammaan qaybaha.
landing.tailoredGuidanceDesc: Khataraha internetku ma joogsadaan markaad ka baxdo. Geli agab gaar ah, nidaamyo, iyo talo wax ku ool ah oo si gaar ah loogu sameeyay baahiyaha qaybtaada.
landing.incidentPlaybooksDesc: Tilmaamo tallaabo-tallaabo ah oo ku saabsan xakamaynta iyo ciribtirka khataraha firfircoon ee deegaankaaga.
landing.complianceFrameworksDesc: Koontaroolada la qariiradeeyay ee ISO 27001, NIST CSF, iyo waajibaadka amniga internetka ee qaranka.
landing.threatModelingDesc: Dukumentiyada la jaangooyey si loo aqoonsado dayacanka naqshadaha ka hor inta aan la gaynin.
landing.securityKitsDesc: Boodhadhka daabacan, qaababka iimaylka, iyo soo jeedinta ololayaasha gudaha.
landing.alertRansomwareDesc: Weerar madax-furasho oo isku dubaridan ayaa lagu beegsanayaa kaabayaasha qaranka. Hubi in dhammaan nidaamyada la cusboonaysiiyay oo kaydinta khadka tooska ah la xafiday si degdeg ah.
landing.alertPhishingDesc: Dambiilayaasha intarneedka ayaa diraya iimaylo been abuur ah oo iska dhigaya maamulka canshuuraha. Ha riixin xiriiriyeyaasha ama ha ka soo dejisan lifaaqyada kuwa dirayaasha aan la aqoon.
landing.alertBrowserPatchDesc: Iibiyeyaasha shabakadda ee waaweyn ayaa sii daayay cusbooneysiin muhiim ah si ay wax uga qabtaan dayacanka eber-maalin ee makiinadaha wax bixinta. Fadlan cusboonaysii si degdeg ah.
landing.ctaTitle: Ku biir Difaaca Qaranka ee Internetka
landing.ctaDesc: Amniga internetka waa mas'uuliyad la wadaago. Isku qalabeeyo aqoonta aad ku aqoonsan karto khataraha oo aad ku ilaalinayso qaabka nolosha dhijitaalka ah ee qarankayaga.
landing.aboutDesc: Xariirka Wacyigelinta Amniga Intarneedka Qaranka waa maamulka dhexe ee u heellan dhismaha bulsho dijitaal ah oo adkeysi leh, ammaan ah, oo xog ogaal u ah dhammaan muwaadiniinta. Iyadoo loo marayo waxbarashada firfircoon, wadaaga macluumaadka khatarta ah ee isha furan, iyo iskaashiga dawladda iyo qaybta gaarka ah, waxaan awood siinaynaa muwaadin kasta si uu isaga difaaco khataraha internetka.
landing.coreMissionDesc1: Khataraha internetku ma joogsadaan markaad ka baxdo. Anaguna ma yeelno. Hadafkayaga keliya waa inaan xaqiijino in internetka uu ahaado jawi ammaan ah oo hal-abuurku uu ku kobco, xogta la ilaaliyo, isgaarsiinta maalinlaha ahna ay ka badbaado jilayaasha xun.
landing.coreMissionDesc2: Iyadoo loo marayo waxbarashada firfircoon, wadaaga xogta khatarta furan, iyo iskaashiga dawladda iyo kuwa gaarka ah, waxaan dhisaynaa gaashaan dhijitaal ah muwaadin kasta.
landing.proactiveDefenseDesc: Horumarinta awoodaha si loo ogaado oo loo baabi'iyo khataraha ka hor intaysan saameyn isticmaalayaasha.
landing.nationalEducationDesc: Nidaaminta manhajka amniga internetka ee dugsiyada, ganacsiyada, iyo dawladda.
landing.unifiedResponseDesc: Isku dubaridka moodooyinka jawaab-celinta degdega ah ee dhammaan qaybaha dadweynaha iyo kuwa gaarka ah.
landing.whoWeServeDesc: Amniga internetka waa difaac qaran oo wadajir ah. Xarunta INSA waxay bixisaa koorsooyin heersare ah, qalab wax ku ool ah, iyo habraacyo loogu talagalay dhammaan waaxaha bulshada.
landing.citizensFamiliesDesc: Koorsooyin is-barid ah, su'aalo qoraal ah, iyo shahaadooyin la xaqiijiyey oo awood siinaya shakhsiyaadka si ay si ammaan ah ugu dhex maraan dunida dijitaalka ah.
landing.citizensPill1: Koorsooyin tayo sare leh oo bilaash ah
landing.smallBusinessesDesc: Nidaamyo wax ku ool ah oo tababarka shaqaalaha, habraacyada siyaasadda amniga, iyo ilaalinta xogta macaamiisha.
landing.businessPill3: Codsiyada tababarka gaarka ah ee hay'adaha
landing.governmentAgenciesDesc: Digniinaha khatarta degdegga ah ee qaranka, heerarka u hoggaansanaanta amniga, iyo ilaalinta kaabayaasha muhiimka ah.
landing.govPill1: Digniinaha khatarta amniga ee degdegga ah

landing.ctaReadyDesc: Ku biir malaayiin muwaadiniin kale ah kuwaas oo balan qaaday inay ku dhaqmaan dhaqan ammaan ah oo internetka ah.

awarenessData.phishingProtectionDesc: Baro sida loo aqoonsado loona fogaado isku dayada khiyaanada ee lagu beegsanayo xogtaada gaarka ah iyo tan shaqada.
awarenessData.phishingProtectionSec1Desc: Aqoonso calaamadaha caadiga ah ee iimayllada khiyaanada ka hor inta aadan gujin.
awarenessData.phishingProtectionSec1Bul1: Hubi cinwaanka soo diraha khaladaadka higgaadda ama xayndaabyada aan caadiga ahayn
awarenessData.phishingProtectionSec1Bul2: Kormeer xiriirinta adigoo dul dhigaya jiirka ka hor inta aadan gujin si aad u aragto halka ay ku geynayso
awarenessData.phishingProtectionSec1Bul3: Ka digtoonow fariimaha degdegga ah ee dalbanaya tallaabo degdeg ah
awarenessData.phishingProtectionSec1Bul4: Ka shakiso lifaaqyada aan la codsan ama baaqyada soo dejinta
awarenessData.phishingProtectionSec2Desc: Dhis caadooyin kaa ilaalinaya xiriirinta xaasidnimada leh meel kasta oo ay ka muuqdaan.
awarenessData.phishingProtectionSec2Bul1: Kalliya toos ugu tag boggaga internetka halkii aad isticmaali lahayd xiriirinta iimaylka
awarenessData.phishingProtectionSec2Bul2: Xaqiiji URL-yada la soo gaabiyay ka hor inta aadan booqan
awarenessData.phishingProtectionSec2Bul3: Raadi HTTPS iyo magacyada xayndaabka saxda ah ee baarka cinwaanka
awarenessData.phishingProtectionSec2Bul4: Isticmaal qalabka baarista xiriirinta ka hor inta aadan furin URL-yada laga shakisan yahay
awarenessData.phishingProtectionSec3Desc: Tallaabo degdeg ah marka aad la kulanto khiyaano waxay dadka kale ka ilaalisaa dhibaatada.
awarenessData.phishingProtectionSec3Bul1: U sheeg fariimaha laga shakisan yahay kooxda amniga ee hay'addaada
awarenessData.phishingProtectionSec3Bul2: Ha u gudbin iimayllada khiyaanada saaxiibbadaada shaqada
awarenessData.phishingProtectionSec3Bul3: Isla markiiba xannib cinwaanka soo diraha app-kaaga iimaylka
awarenessData.phishingProtectionSec3Bul4: Haddii aad xog gelisay, isla markiiba beddel furayaasha sirta ah
awarenessData.phishingProtectionSec4Desc: Ku dar lakab dheeraad ah oo amni ah akoonnadaada marka laga reebo furaha sirta ah.
awarenessData.phishingProtectionSec4Bul2: Ka doorbid codsiyada xaqiijinta (Authenticator apps) koodhadhka SMS-ka
awarenessData.phishingProtectionSec4Bul3: U isticmaal furayaasha amniga qalabka adag (Hardware keys) akoonnada muhiimka ah
awarenessData.phishingProtectionSec4Bul4: Weligaa ha la wadaagin koodhkaaga 2FA qofna, xitaa haddii ay ku weydiiyaan
awarenessData.passwordHygieneDesc: Abuur oo maaree furayaal sir ah oo adag si aad akoonnadaada uga ilaaliso weerarrada.
awarenessData.passwordHygieneSec1Title: Abuurista Furayaal Sir ah oo Adag
awarenessData.passwordHygieneSec1Desc: Baro sida loo sameeyo furayaal sir ah oo ay adag tahay in la qiyaaso laakiin sahlan in la xusuusto.
awarenessData.passwordHygieneSec1Bul1: Isticmaal ugu yaraan 12 xaraf, tirooyin iyo calaamado
awarenessData.passwordHygieneSec1Bul2: Ka fogow isticmaalka xogta shakhsi ahaaneed (taariikhda dhalashada, magacyada)
awarenessData.passwordHygieneSec1Bul3: Isticmaal weedho sir ah (passphrases) oo ka kooban ereyo aan xiriir lahayn
awarenessData.passwordHygieneSec1Bul4: Ha isticmaalin taxanaha kiiboodhka (sida 123456 ama qwerty)
awarenessData.passwordHygieneSec2Desc: U isticmaal maareeyayaasha furaha sirta ah si aad u keydiso dhammaan furayaashaada si ammaan ah.
awarenessData.passwordHygieneSec2Bul1: U samee furayaal sir ah oo gaar ah akoon kasta
awarenessData.passwordHygieneSec2Bul2: Ha ku qorin furayaasha sirta ah buug ama biraawsarkaaga si bayaan ah
awarenessData.passwordHygieneSec2Bul3: Furaha sirta ah ee ugu weyn (Master Password) ka dhig mid aad u adag
awarenessData.passwordHygieneSec2Bul4: Ku ilaali maareeyaha furaha sirta ah xaqiijinta labada arrimood (2FA)
awarenessData.passwordHygieneSec3Desc: Ku dar difaac dheeraad ah oo ilaalinaya akoonkaaga xitaa haddii furahaaga la xado.
awarenessData.passwordHygieneSec3Bul1: Ka kici 2FA dhammaan akoonnada muhiimka ah
awarenessData.passwordHygieneSec3Bul2: Isticmaal barnaamijyada xaqiijinta halkii aad SMS isticmaali lahayd
awarenessData.passwordHygieneSec3Bul3: Ku keydi koodhadhka gurmadka (Backup codes) meel ammaan ah
awarenessData.passwordHygieneSec3Bul4: Isla markiiba digtoonow haddii aad hesho koodh aadan codsan
awarenessData.passwordHygieneSec4Desc: Ogow goorta iyo inta jeer ee aad beddeleyso furahaaga sirta ah amniga ugu habboon.
awarenessData.passwordHygieneSec4Bul1: Isla markiiba beddel furayaasha sirta ah haddii aad ka shakido jebin
awarenessData.passwordHygieneSec4Bul2: Beddel furayaasha akoonnada la wadaago saddexdii biloodba mar
awarenessData.passwordHygieneSec4Bul3: Ka fogow beddelka aadka u badan haddii aan loo baahnayn
awarenessData.passwordHygieneSec4Bul4: Isticmaal qalabka hubinta furaha si aad u tijaabiso awoodda furahaaga
awarenessData.secureBrowsingDesc: Ilaali xogtaada gaarka ah iyo qalabkaaga inta aad internetka ku jirto.
awarenessData.secureBrowsingSec1Desc: Hubi in boggaga aad booqaneyso ay yihiin kuwo la aamini karo oo la qariyey.
awarenessData.secureBrowsingSec1Bul1: Hubi sumadda qufulka iyo HTTPS ee bilowga URL-ka
awarenessData.secureBrowsingSec1Bul2: Ka fogow booqashada boggaga internetka ee bixiya digniinaha amniga
awarenessData.secureBrowsingSec1Bul3: Xaqiiji in magaca xayndaabka bogga si sax ah loo qoray
awarenessData.secureBrowsingSec1Bul4: Xaddid cookies-ka qolo saddexaad ee aan la xaqiijin
awarenessData.secureBrowsingSec2Desc: Ka digtoonow markaad ku xiran tahay shabakadaha internetka ee dadweynaha.
awarenessData.secureBrowsingSec2Bul1: Ha ku qaban hawlaha bangiga ama xogta sirta ah Wi-Fi-ga dadweynaha
awarenessData.secureBrowsingSec2Bul2: Mar walba isticmaal VPN la aamini karo
awarenessData.secureBrowsingSec2Bul3: Dami wadaagista faylasha iyo isku xirnaanta tooska ah
awarenessData.secureBrowsingSec2Bul4: Ka go' shabakadda marka aad dhammeyso shaqadaada
awarenessData.secureBrowsingSec3Desc: Ka ilaali biraawsarkaaga kordhinta halista ah.
awarenessData.secureBrowsingSec3Bul1: Kaliya ka soo degso kordhinta dukaamada rasmiga ah oo la aaminsan yahay
awarenessData.secureBrowsingSec3Bul2: Ka saar kordhinta duugoobay ee aadan isticmaalin
awarenessData.secureBrowsingSec3Bul3: Si taxadar leh u baar oggolaanshaha ay codsadaan kordhintu
awarenessData.secureBrowsingSec4Desc: Amaan ku joog markaad ku xiranto shabakadaha ka baxsan gurigaaga ama xafiiskaaga.
awarenessData.secureBrowsingSec4Bul1: Ka fogow gelitaanka akoonnada xasaasiga ah Wi-Fi-ga dadweynaha
awarenessData.secureBrowsingSec4Bul2: Isticmaal VPN si aad u qariso xogtaada shabakadaha aan la aaminin
awarenessData.secureBrowsingSec4Bul3: Dami wadaagista faylasha iyo AirDrop meelaha fagaaraha ah
awarenessData.secureBrowsingSec4Bul4: Hilmaan shabakadda ka dib isticmaalka si aad uga hortagto dib-u-xirnaansho toos ah
awarenessData.dataPrivacyDesc: Ka ilaali xogta sirta ah ee shakhsi ahaaneed iyo tan hay'adda tuugada iyo marin-u-helka aan la oggolayn.
awarenessData.dataPrivacySec1Desc: Faham sida loo aqoonsado xogta u baahan ilaalinta adag.
awarenessData.dataPrivacySec1Bul1: Lambarrada aqoonsiga, akoonnada bangiga iyo xogta caafimaadku waa sir
awarenessData.dataPrivacySec1Bul2: Xogta shakhsiga ah ee shaqaalaha iyo macaamiisha waa in si taxadar leh loo qabtaa
awarenessData.dataPrivacySec1Bul3: Ilaali furayaasha sirta ah si aan cidina u arkin
awarenessData.dataPrivacySec1Bul4: Ka ilaali dadka aan fasaxa u haysan inay arkaan xogta sirta ah
awarenessData.dataPrivacySec2Desc: Raac xeerarka amniga markaad wadaageyso faylasha iyo dukumintiyada.
awarenessData.dataPrivacySec2Bul1: Qari (Encrypt) dukumintiyada sirta ah ka hor inta aadan dirin
awarenessData.dataPrivacySec2Bul2: Xaqiiji inaad faylasha la wadaagto qofka saxda ah oo keliya
awarenessData.dataPrivacySec2Bul3: Ha ku wadaagin dukumintiyada shaqada iimaylka gaarka ah ama baraha bulshada
awarenessData.dataPrivacySec2Bul4: Si ammaan ah u tirtir xogta aan loo baahnayn
awarenessData.dataPrivacySec3Desc: Ixtiraam sharciyada amniga sayberka ee hay'addaada iyo waddankaaga.
awarenessData.dataPrivacySec3Bul1: Raac tilmaamaha iyo xeerarka amniga sayberka ee INSA
awarenessData.dataPrivacySec3Bul2: Isla markiiba u sheeg maamulka haddii uu dhaco jebin xogeed
awarenessData.dataPrivacySec3Bul3: Si joogto ah uga qaybgal tababarrada maaraynta xogta
awarenessData.dataPrivacySec3Bul4: U isticmaal qarinta xogta qalabka (Device Encryption) dhammaan qalabkaaga
awarenessData.dataPrivacySec4Desc: Habee qalabka iyo nidaamyada si aad u yarayso kashifaadaada dhijitaalka ah.
awarenessData.dataPrivacySec4Bul1: U isticmaal daalacashada gaarka ah (Incognito) raadinta xasaasiga ah
awarenessData.dataPrivacySec4Bul2: Ka kici biraawsarkaaga diidmada raad-raaca (Do Not Track)
awarenessData.dataPrivacySec4Bul3: Isticmaal matoorrada raadinta ee aan diiwaangelin taariikhdaada
awarenessData.dataPrivacySec4Bul4: Si joogto ah u hubi marin-u-helka qolo saddexaad ee akoonnadaada
awarenessData.incidentResponseDesc: Qaado tallaabooyin degdeg ah oo sax ah si aad u yarayso waxyeellada weerarka sayberka.
awarenessData.incidentResponseSec1Desc: Ogow calaamadaha muujinaya in qalabkaaga ama akoonkaaga la weeraray.
awarenessData.incidentResponseSec1Bul1: Qalabka oo si lama filaan ah u noqda mid aad u gaabis ah ama xirma
awarenessData.incidentResponseSec1Bul2: Barnaamijyo ama faylal aanad furin oo iskood u furma
awarenessData.incidentResponseSec1Bul3: Fariimo aan la garanayn oo akoonkaaga looga dirayo dadka kale
awarenessData.incidentResponseSec1Bul4: Markaad aragto in furahaaga sirta ah la beddelay ama la xiray
awarenessData.incidentResponseSec2Desc: Tallaabooyin degdeg ah oo la qaado si loo xaddido waxyeellada.
awarenessData.incidentResponseSec2Bul1: Isla markiiba ka jar qalabka internetka iyo Wi-Fi-ga
awarenessData.incidentResponseSec2Bul2: Ha damin qalabka gebi ahaanba, u daa baaritaanka
awarenessData.incidentResponseSec2Bul3: Qor calaamadaha iyo waqtiga ay dhacdaddu dhacday
awarenessData.incidentResponseSec2Bul4: Ka beddel furayaashaada sirta ah qalab kale oo ammaan ah
awarenessData.incidentResponseSec3Desc: U sheeg dhacdada INSA ama kooxda sayberka ee hay'addaada waqtigeeda.
awarenessData.incidentResponseSec3Bul1: Isla markiiba u wargeli qaybta amniga sayberka
awarenessData.incidentResponseSec3Bul2: Si cad oo sax ah u sharax waxa dhacay
awarenessData.incidentResponseSec3Bul3: Si adag u raac tilmaamaha khuburada
awarenessData.incidentResponseSec3Bul4: Ha isticmaalin qalabka la shakisan yahay ilaa baaritaanku dhammaado
awarenessData.incidentResponseSec4Desc: Dib u soo celi nidaamyadaada oo ka hortag dhacdooyinka mustaqbalka.
awarenessData.incidentResponseSec4Bul1: Ku samee baaritaan buuxa oo fayras qalabka waxyeelloobay
awarenessData.incidentResponseSec4Bul2: Dib u soo celi xogta gurmadka nadiifka ah ee la xaqiijiyay
awarenessData.incidentResponseSec4Bul3: Dib u eeg oo adkee dhammaan dejinta amniga akoonnadaada
awarenessData.incidentResponseSec4Bul4: Qor dhacdada iyo casharrada laga bartay ka-hortagga mustaqbalka
awarenessData.cyberHygieneBasicsDesc: Dhis caadooyin lagama maarmaan ah si aad noloshaada dhijitaalka ah uga dhigto mid ammaan ah.
awarenessData.cyberHygieneBasicsSec1Desc: Ka dhig amniga qalabkaaga iyo barnaamijyadaada mid casri ah.
awarenessData.cyberHygieneBasicsSec1Bul1: Ku rakib cusbooneysiinta nidaamka hawlgalka (OS) adigoon dib u dhigin
awarenessData.cyberHygieneBasicsSec1Bul2: Daar cusbooneysiinta amniga ee tooska ah
awarenessData.cyberHygieneBasicsSec1Bul3: Ka saar barnaamijyada duugoobay ee aan la isticmaalin
awarenessData.cyberHygieneBasicsSec1Bul4: Mar walba cusbooneysii software-kaaga ka hortagga fayraska
awarenessData.cyberHygieneBasicsSec2Desc: Diyaari hab aad si fudud dib ugu heli karto xogtaada haddii ay lunto ama la xado.
awarenessData.cyberHygieneBasicsSec2Bul1: Raac qaanuunka 3-2-1 (3 nuqul, 2 warbaahin oo kala duwan, 1 meel ka baxsan)
awarenessData.cyberHygieneBasicsSec2Bul2: Ku keydi dukumintiyada muhiimka ah daruuraha (Cloud) ama hard drive dibadeed
awarenessData.cyberHygieneBasicsSec2Bul3: Si joogto ah u tijaabi in nuqullada la keydiyay ay shaqeynayaan
awarenessData.cyberHygieneBasicsSec2Bul4: Ku ilaali nuqullada keydsan furaha sirta ah
awarenessData.cyberHygieneBasicsSec3Desc: Si fiican u ilaali taleefannadaada, laptops-kaaga iyo tablets-kaaga.
awarenessData.cyberHygieneBasicsSec3Bul1: U isticmaal PIN adag ama biometric dhammaan qalabkaaga
awarenessData.cyberHygieneBasicsSec3Bul2: Ha kaga tagin qalabka meelaha aan la garanayn kormeer la'aan
awarenessData.cyberHygieneBasicsSec3Bul3: Ha ku xirin kombuyuutarkaaga USB flash aan la garanayn
awarenessData.cyberHygieneBasicsSec3Bul4: Dami xiriirinta Bluetooth iyo Wi-Fi marka aadan isticmaalin
awarenessData.cyberHygieneBasicsSec4Desc: Ilaali marin-u-helka muuqaalka ah ee qalabkaaga mar kasta.
awarenessData.cyberHygieneBasicsSec4Bul1: U isticmaal PIN, fure ama biometrics adag dhammaan qalabka
awarenessData.cyberHygieneBasicsSec4Bul2: Habee inuu si toos ah u qufulmo muddo gaaban ka dib
awarenessData.cyberHygieneBasicsSec4Bul3: Daar awoodda tirtiridda xogta fogaanta (Remote wipe) haddii qalabku lumo
awarenessData.cyberHygieneBasicsSec4Bul4: Weligaa ha kaga tagin qalabka meelaha dadweynaha kormeer la'aan
awarenessData.testKnowledgeDescPart1: Qaado qalabkeena is-qiimeynta si aad u qiimeyso fahamkaaga ku saabsan
awarenessData.testKnowledgeDescPart2: oo aad u ogaato meelaha u baahan hagaajinta.
awarenessData.awarenessTopicsDesc: Sahami hagayaal wax ku ool ah iyo tallaabooyin la qaadi karo si aad naftaada iyo hay'addaada uga ilaaliso khataraha sayberka ee caadiga ah.
